fields.Name: IT02 - RunQuery Cache Integrity
fields.Description: RunQuery result cache (Q1-Q21): TTL and smart-validation modes, slot fingerprinting, permission parity, and query definition changes. The whole bundle mutates the DB by design: it creates/tears down a Query Category + two Queries via a driver-level try/finally inside the bundle, creates/deletes MJ: User Settings rows the fixture queries count, and Q13-Q19 create and edit their own throwaway queries. Q10 verifies a TTL slot serves byte-identical row data on the hit. Q13-Q19 verify that editing a query's SQL, a parameter's validation filters, a composed query, or the platform SQL variant makes the next cached run miss with the new SQL's rows; that a description edit does not; that requests by ID, name or both share one slot; and that an edited query's old slots are deleted once the edit settles. Q20-Q21 verify that smart validation answers stale when the client's slot came from another query definition, and that a client sending no definition hash keeps data-only validation.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: current/stale/no_validation statuses correct; MaxRows/Parameters fingerprint separately; TTL slot serves byte-identical row data on the hit; failed executions never cached; a result-affecting query edit makes the next run miss with the new rows and a descriptive edit does not; edited queries' slots are deleted; a definition mismatch is stale on client validation; fixtures cleaned up.
